summary: Vale S.A. filed a routine Form 6-K disclosing the semi-annual remuneration payment on its participating debentures, not a special situation. Payment of R$1.712064114 gross per debenture totals R$512,161,695.81 across 299,148,666 outstanding debentures remaining after the 2025 optional acquisition offer settled 89,410,390 debentures from the 6th issuance. Record date is the September 29, 2026 B3/Bradesco custody close, with financial settlement October 1, 2026. Withholding tax applies at fixed-income rates unless exemption is proven. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or change-of-control terms are stated; watch only debenture-holder tax treatment and custody mechanics.
